entries.what: opens a new window (like a browser tab)
entries.example: press Ctrl+b, let go, press c
entries.run: tmux new-window -t t; tmux list-windows -t t | wc -l

entries.what: splits the current pane into two side by side
entries.run: tmux split-window -h -t t; tmux list-panes -t t -F '#{pane_index}:#{pane_width}'

entries.example: press Ctrl+b, let go, press n
entries.setup: tmux new-session -d -x 80 -y 24 -s t; tmux new-window -t t; tmux select-window -t t:0
entries.run: tmux next-window -t t; tmux display-message -p -t t '#{window_index}'

entries.what: leaves tmux but keeps everything running; get back with 'tmux attach'
entries.example: press Ctrl+b, let go, press d

entries.what: print what is on a pane's screen as plain text
entries.run: tmux send-keys -t t 'echo hello' Enter; sleep 1; tmux capture-pane -p -t t | grep -c '^hello$'
